en.t: It would be good if it were the room where the old man is staying.

units.source_text: 那间很宽敞，把老大爷撵走就很清静，住多久都行，还可以学习呢。”

en.t: That room is spacious, and if we drove the old man out it would be quiet; I could stay as long as I liked, and I could study there too.

units.source_text: 她们彼此商量了一阵子，然后对我说，“我们有两间小房，山上那间是闲着的。”

en.t: They discussed it among themselves for a while, and then said to me, "We have two small rooms, and the one up on the mountain is empty."
